picks.reasoning: LPL has beaten LEC 4-2 this year and LPL sits at 64% against other regions versus LEC's 50%, and BLG has the deeper record and a First Stand title to show for it. BLGViper is the kind of bottom laner who decides a single game, and I don't care that MKOI's late-game comebacks look exciting on paper.

This is tempo over comebacks: BLG leads the early game with +1.4k GD@15, converts 9 of 10 leads at 15, and sits on the stronger LPL side, which went 4-2 against the LEC this year. MKOI's late-game comeback habit is real, but it only matters if BLG lets the early map slip.

LPL has the stronger international record here (64% against other regions versus LEC's 50%), and BLG's pool is deep, with Yunara and Lulu on six picks each, so I expect them to set the draft and win it. MKOI's comeback habit and Supa's ceiling keep this from being a lock, but BLG already beat them 1-0 this year.

LPL holds the edge here: 4-2 against LEC in 2026 and 64% vs 50% win rates against other regions, with BLG's 50-12 series record and 4-0 First Stand run well ahead of MKOI's 22-20. BLG's late-game throws are a real risk, so I'm not going higher than this.

BLG's composure and steady 50-12 run read like a group that trusts each other, even if they have thrown a couple of leads. LPL also holds the edge internationally (64% vs LEC's 50% against other regions) and beat MKOI 1-0 this year, so I'm backing the team with the stronger region and the calmer room.
